spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact selector through three parser entry points (Selectors API, CSS.supports selector(), a rendered @supports block cross-checked via computed style), the idle no-match invariant, the eligible-source list from §2.2, and the matching lifetime via a live sampler.

interactive.rationale: Re-run probes button, a real sampler link plus a click-it-for-me control, and a timeline that fills with genuine matches() results across an intercepted navigation.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index promises parse probes, the idle invariant, eligible sources and a lifetime sampler; all four panels exist and run.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the unsupported tier (throws recorded raw, three entry points shown agreeing), the no-Navigation-API tier (sampler blocked with reason), parser-consistency checking, and the bystander negative control.

references.rationale: chromestatus entry, spec section and MDN Navigation API linked.

conformance.rationale: This page is the runtime companion to the feature suite: every scriptable assertion (both parsers, compound, idle no-match, div never-match) has a visible counterpart probe, and the manual lifetime assertion names this sampler.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via CDP: probes table shows throws-SyntaxError/false/false with the @supports chip grey and marked consistent; the autorun sampler ran a real 1s intercepted navigation with every sample honestly recording throws SyntaxError and the verdict stating it; console clean; mobile emulation overflow-free. On this browser the honest-unsupported path is the complete story, and this page's job is precisely to report it.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts parser agreement, the idle invariant when runnable, the fallback branch, sampler lifetime (supported) or honest-unsupported (otherwise), and the bystander control.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; the @supports chip's applied state is black-on-emerald (5.1:1); result cells use emerald/rose on paper; tables scroll in wrappers on narrow screens.

accessibility.rationale: Probes and sources are real tables with scoped headers, the timeline is a role=log region, the verdict is aria-live, and both sampler triggers are keyboard-operable with visible focus.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-emulated 360x740 DPR3: zero horizontal overflow (tables scroll in their wrappers), no console errors.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive demo control panel sliders without horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep wide tabular content inside its own scroll container rather than letting it stretch the page (css/css-layout guidance).
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Both probe tables sit in .table-wrap { overflow-x: auto } wrappers; the 360px emulation shows zero page-level overflow.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Live-updating results need text equivalents and keyboard reachability.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The timeline is a focusable role=log list and the verdict is an aria-live output; all triggers are buttons/links with focus-visible.

openQuestions.title: Record the supported-browser timeline shape
openQuestions.detail: On Chrome 156 the sampler should read false → true (during the 1s trip) → false, with the bystander false throughout. Run it there and paste the observed timeline into the page as reference output beside the note that currently describes it in prose.

openQuestions.title: Does a programmatic link.click() produce a source element?
openQuestions.detail: The click-it-for-me button drives link.click(). The spec ties matching to the navigation's source element; verify on a 156 build that a synthetic click on an anchor still yields that anchor as source (as it does for navigation), and if not, instruct users to click the link directly and update the sampler copy.

summary: Inspection bench for :navigation-source: three parser entry points cross-checked, the idle no-match invariant, the eligible-source table, and a real matches() lifetime sampler across an intercepted navigation. On Chromium 141 every probe honestly reports unsupported (throws/false/grey chip, all consistent) — verified headless with clean console on desktop and emulated mobile.
